name: Adrián Rivera Ferrán
title: Photo & Video Content Creator
headline: Product, process, and people. Shot, cut, and built for social.
subline: Photographer, videographer, and content lead. Nine years with consumer brands in New York and Puerto Rico.
hero_caption: Six cookies stacked and cut open to show their fillings, shot for Chip City in New York City
bio: I'm Adrián Rivera Ferrán, a photo and video creator in New York. For three years I ran the content engine at Chip City Cookies: product, reels, paid video and static ads every month, collabs with Eggo, Pringles and TBS, and the company's training series.

Before that I directed a TV spot for Puerto Rico's largest açaí brand and made content for Nestlé and Magnum at AdWorks. I edit in Premiere and After Effects, and I build AI-assisted workflows and ad creative that keep the product true to life.
cta: Open to full-time and freelance roles in brand content, social video, and AI-assisted creative. Let's talk.
